title: Information and Noise
grammar: Possibility and probability: könnyen meglehet, hogy; nem kizárt, hogy
goal: I can say what may have happened to a message (*könnyen meglehet, hogy*, *nem kizárt, hogy*, *kellett, hogy legyen*).
I can name the words of information theory (*információs entrópia*, *zaj*, *redundancia*).
I can write one sentence about an error in a message.

sections.title: Unit 35: Information, Machines and Digital Ethics
body: The digital age raises questions about information, about privacy and about the difference between a machine and a mind.

This unit is built around Neumann János (John von Neumann) and his book *A számológép és az agy* (1958), published after his death. You recap possibility, participles, requests, comparison and *mintha*, and learn the words for digital ethics.
